title: Left
description: Return characters from the left of text. Strings shorter than the length defined will be unaffected.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name of the column(s) to edit.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of characters to include from the left. If negative, this will remove the specified number of characters from the left. May not equal 0.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Select characters from the left of the input. Using a negative length reverses the side of selection, selecting from the right. ## Migrated examples #### Selecting Three Leftmost Elements ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - select.left: input: Column output: Result length: 3 ```
##### Input Sample | Column | | --- | | pudding |
##### Output Sample | Result | | --- | | pud |
